description: e2000fs_calib9_lnmix. e2000fs_calib2_mixture2comp with its four heuristics replaced by one likelihood, fitted with XGBoostLSS (Chevalier & Cote 2025, Eur. Actuar. J., Algorithm 4): the 3K-1 parameter groups of a latent-regime log-normal mixture, p(y|x)=sum_k pi_k(x) LogNormal(mu_k(x), sigma_k(x)), are updated cyclically for two cycles of 450 Newton boosting rounds each while the other groups are held at their most recent prediction function, from an ML initialisation. The reported forecast is the mixture expectation sum_k pi_k exp(mu_k + sigma_k^2/2). Removed: (i) the level head's 4x sample weight above 550 km/s (now the unweighted NLL of the same rows), (ii) clip(1,3000) on every head (the family is supported on (0, inf); 0 cells reach either bound), (iii) the binary head regressing 1{y>=550} (now the latent mixing weight pi(x); a threshold is never formed and P(y>=c) is read off the fitted CDF for any c), (iv) the gap head trained on rows whose block crosses 550 km/s (now the component locations and scales, estimated from every row). mu_0=m0 and mu_k=m0+sum softplus(delta_i) make label switching impossible, so nothing is sorted, routed or blended afterwards: one likelihood, one booster per parameter group, no gate and no stacked ensemble. Two regimes is the physical slow/fast bimodality of the solar wind at 1 AU (Larrodera & Cid 2020, A&A 638 A72), which 550 km/s only approximated; K was confirmed by held-out conditional NLL on matured December data. All xgboost hyper-parameters are the frozen recipe unchanged. Refit on the F1/F2/F3 quarters with cutoffs 2025-12-29 / 2026-03-29 / 2026-06-29 and 72 h target maturity; forecasts all 6,315 origins unconditionally.

data.feature_set: df.parquet Top30 (21 constant + 24 h x 9 varying per block)

fitting_scheme.name: XGBoostLSS
fitting_scheme.reference: Chevalier & Cote 2025, Eur. Actuar. J. 10.1007/s13385-025-00428-5, Algorithm 4
fitting_scheme.order: eta, m0, delta, rho_0, rho_1 (cycled); others held at the most recent function

objective.family: latent-regime log-normal mixture, joint maximum likelihood
objective.density: p(y|x)=sum_k pi_k LogNormal(mu_k, sigma_k); pi=softmax(eta), sigma=exp(rho)
objective.point_forecast: sum_k pi_k exp(mu_k + sigma_k^2/2); no clipping
objective.identification: mu_0=m0, mu_k=m0+sum_{i<=k} softplus(delta_i); label switching impossible
objective.hessian: diagonal Fisher times a per-group 1/mean-Hessian unit conversion
